description:
A very special Hachita build.

I few years ago I was introduced to Jacquie Phalen…the original pro female mountain biker. Jacquie is Charlie's partner and was kind enough to sell me a few things from their collection. A high honor. This is the result.

Geniune Charlie Cunningham wheels and tires…from Charlie and Jacquie‘s place in Marin. OG WTB grease guard hubs…boost before there was boost. Stupid easy service.

Charlie's cranks from his shop.

OG WTB grease guard headset…yes, just squirt in some grease and you're good..

Suntour roller cams…stamped “Cunningham Design” right on em.

Super cool everything else…this is an incredible build dripping in character and history. Someone needs to ride and enjoy this thing
